name: squads
description: Build football line-ups and animated tactical plays with the Squads MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
Squads is a free football (soccer) tactics board. With this connector, ChatGPT can draw line-ups and animate plays for you and show them on a board inside the chat.

What you can do
- Draw a line-up: starters, substitutes, formation and team colors, optionally with the opponent. Great for match previews, famous line-ups from history, or your own Sunday-league team.
- Animate a play: build-up patterns, pressing, counter-attacks, set pieces or a real match situation, moved scene by scene on the full pitch (up to 30 scenes / 60 seconds) and played back in the chat.
- 25 formation presets (4-4-2, 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1, 3-5-2, 5-3-2, classics such as WM and Catenaccio) plus custom shapes built line by line.

Every result comes with a share link. Open it in the Squads app to keep editing, export a PNG image, or export an MP4 video (desktop). Check the summary of positions in the reply, and ask ChatGPT to fix anything that looks wrong (for example, “left and right are swapped”).

Privacy
No account and no authentication are required. The connector receives only what ChatGPT sends when it calls a tool (team names, player names, positions). Squads discards board content after responding; the line-up or play exists only inside the share link. The hosting provider may process access logs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me create a football line-up or tactical play with Squads.
